items.title: UK convicts "Bitcoin Queen" in world’s largest cryptocurrency seizure
items.description: The Metropolitan Police has secured a conviction in what is believed to be the world's largest cryptocurrency seizure, valued at more than £5.5 billion ($7.3 billion). [...]

items.title: IoT Security Flounders Amid Churning Risk
items.description: The Internet of Things (IoT) has made everything more interconnected than ever, but an important US government security initiative is stuck in limbo even as threat actors step up attacks on everything from medical gear to printers.

items.title: Sneaky, Malicious MCP Server Exfiltrates Secrets via BCC
items.description: The first known malicious MCP server is an AI integration tool that automatically sends email such as those related to password resets, account confirmations, security alerts, invoices, and receipts to threat actors.
